name: TCP over a lossy hop
about: C writes 3000 bytes to a discard service on S through a switch whose port toward S is a token bucket (burst 1700, queue 1600 bytes, 10 Mbit/s). The first two 1448-byte segments get through, the third (104 bytes) finds the queue full and is dropped by the switch, and the client's retransmission timer sends it again 200 ms later.
